## Testing Mode
RED

## What
Write failing unit tests for the _adf_to_text helper in tests/scripts/test_bridge_inbound.py. The helper does not exist yet — all tests must fail at import (ImportError or AttributeError).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Test file: tests/scripts/test_bridge_inbound.py
- Import: from bridge._inbound_utils import _adf_to_text
- Test cases (5):
  1. Plain string input returns the string unchanged (back-compat): _adf_to_text('hello world') == 'hello world'
  2. ADF dict with 3 paragraphs flattens to lines joined by newlines: {'type':'doc','version':1,'content':[{'type':'paragraph','content':[{'type':'text','text':'line1'}]}, {'type':'paragraph','content':[{'type':'text','text':'line2'}]}, {'type':'paragraph','content':[{'type':'text','text':'line3'}]}]} -> 'line1\nline2\nline3'
  3. ADF dict with unsupported nodes (panels, mediaSingle, mentions) mixed with paragraphs — unsupported silently skipped, text-bearing paragraphs joined
  4. None input returns empty string: _adf_to_text(None) == ''
  5. Empty string input returns empty string: _adf_to_text('') == ''
- All 5 tests must fail (RED) before implementation
- Test names: test_adf_to_text_plain_string, test_adf_to_text_three_paragraphs, test_adf_to_text_unsupported_nodes_skipped, test_adf_to_text_none_input, test_adf_to_text_empty_string

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test_bridge_inbound.py (add test functions)
